{{Top|leg}}
The '''Rq8.Y flight computer''' was a flight control system designed by [[Torplex/Legends|Torplex]].

It was fully-integrated into the popular [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] to translate data from control surfaces to engine performance.

[[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet System]]'s [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptor]] used this model of flight computer with the diagnostic software replaced by a ship-monitoring one produced by [[Kon-Trol]] and dedicated to guiding the [[ion stream deflector]]s.<ref name="XvT">''[[Starfighter Battle Book: X-wing vs TIE Interceptor]]''</ref>
